headline: Edo State Signs MoU with China Express Airline and KDN Aero for Edo Air
summary: The Edo State Government signed a Memorandum of Understanding with China Express Airline and KDN Aero to establish a proposed state-owned carrier, Edo Air.
why: Regional government initiatives to launch state-owned enterprises involve public-private partnerships and international aerospace suppliers. Such ventures impact regional infrastructure and transportation budgets.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: State-level airline venture creates regional transportation infrastructure changes.
